name: intraday-equities-p4mid-s01-h03-ridge-close
notes: P4 arm C carried to the survivor's look-ahead and row spacing: LLY at 3 minutes ahead on ONE-minute rows, the simple model, close. Identical to run-p4mid-h02-ridge-close.json except period_ms (300000 -> 60000) and the lead (2 -> 3), because one-minute rows are what moved the wall and 3 minutes is the furthest look-ahead that cleared the many-attempts bar. Read ONLY against its twin: the quoted window is sixteen months and twelve folds, so both cells carry about half the evidence of a twenty-fold grid row and neither may be read against a long-window number. A minute with no usable two-sided quote is dropped from BOTH sides before anything is built, so the two prices are judged on exactly the same instants. Note what this pair does NOT hold: the survivor is the TREE model with the 'cross' feature block over twenty folds and a 730-day training window, while this pair keeps P4's own geometry (universe-jpm-h20, no feature blocks, 180-day training, twelve folds) so that it is matched to its own control.

universe.notes: The H<=20 grid variant at 5-minute row spacing, with the price field overridden to 'close' (ADR-0065). That one word moves the label, the emitted tape and every lag return together, so a cell can never label with one price and predict from another.

alpaca.notes: Split-adjusted SIP bars (ADR-0063) with the minute NBBO of ADR-0070 joined on the instant: every bar carries mid/bid/ask/spread, None where no two-sided quote fell inside its own sixty seconds. start_ms is 2024-11-01, the first day of the quote pull, because a bar with no quote cannot be scored in either arm and nothing before that day survives the 'quoted' filter anyway. quote_uncovered_price lets a symbol the pull never touched - SPY, AAPL, WMT - keep its trade price in the mid slot, so the market reference and the residual label survive; it changes nothing for the two names being scored, and it is the same in both arms.

session.notes: Regular session only; the store keeps every vendor minute.

momentum_horizons.notes: Few minutes; sharper than the 5m scale in the 46.
Condenses the old L=120 window into ret/rv/mom. cross_session so its warmup is once, not daily.
Few hours, still inside one RTH session. cross_session so its warmup is once, not daily.
Five RTH sessions, about a week.

features.notes: lookback=20 emits one-minute ret_lag columns for the last 20 minutes. Every horizon here is cross_session so none costs rows beyond a one-time warmup; see docs/research/row-loss-is-intra-session-scale-warmup-not-cross-session.md.

tradable.notes: SPY has already entered the residual features; score tradables.

scan.notes: The single lead 2: lead_start is also the training label (ADR-0062), so this cell trains and scores at 2 minute(s) and nowhere else. score_period_ms 1800000 judges only validation rows on the half-hour, the same lattice the P1 grid uses, so the eight cells here are judged on one set of instants. The price the label is built from comes from the universe override, not from here, so the estimator block is untouched between the two arms.

names.notes: The two names with a complete minute NBBO history. AAPL, WMT and SPY have none and JPM's stops on 2025-03-27, so scoring them would compare a midpoint against a trade price. They still build features; only these two are scored.

quoted.notes: The row pin. A minute with no usable two-sided quote is dropped here, BEFORE the features, so the close arm and the mid arm are built and scored on exactly the same instants. About one RTH minute in three thousand for LLY and XOM; every minute before 2024-11-01, and every JPM minute after 2025-03-27, where the pull did not reach.

walkforward.notes: The quoted window is 2024-11-01 to 2026-02-27, so the 20 folds of the P1 grid (first 2022-05-06, 730 training days) do not fit inside it. These twelve are the longest walk the quotes allow: the first fold's training window starts on 2024-11-01, the day the quotes start, and the last fold's validation ends before the 2026-02-27 cut. 180 training days, a 5-day embargo (still longer than any label here), 63 validation days and a 21-day step. Fewer folds than the grid, so the across-fold leg of ADR-0067 has 11 degrees of freedom rather than 19 - the rule uses the p-value at alpha, not a fixed t, so the critical value moves with the count. All eight cells share these folds exactly; nothing here is comparable with a long-window number.
